subject: Recap + Proposed 6-week Trial Outline for Meridian Commerce
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Singh <aisha@meridiancommerce.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + Proposed 6-week Trial Outline for Meridian Commerce

Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our demo and the next steps we discussed, plus a proposed 6-week trial outline attached. High level:

- Goals we heard:
  * Improve search-to-checkout intent extraction (target: +15% relevant intent capture)
  * Reduce average inference latency for live product suggestions to <120ms p95
  * Keep cost per 1k inference tokens under USD $2.50 after batching/quantization

- Proposed success criteria (we can refine):
  1) Precision on intent extraction >= 78% on your labeled holdout
  2) Integration latency p95 <120ms for 95% of test traffic
  3) No data exfiltration; keys remain in your VPC trial instance (Private trial)
  4) Readiness checklist complete and a rolling handoff to your eng team by week 6

I attached a short plan that breaks the trial into 6 weeks (kickoff, integration, run, evaluation, scale, handoff) with owners and checkpoints. High-level timeline: kickoff next Tuesday (Apr 6), pilot data load by Apr 12, 2-week internal run, evaluation week starting Apr 27, handoff by May 11.

Call out items for Meridian to prepare: sample traffic (anonymized), a representative mapping of intents, a point-of-contact for infra work (we discussed Raj), and any procurement docs needed for Dedicated/trial billing.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm the success criteria above or send edits by Thu (Apr 1).
2) Let us know if Apr 6 kickoff works and who from Meridian will join (Raj + engineering lead recommended).
3) We'll provision the Private trial environment and send onboarding links + a short runbook before the kickoff.

Attachment: Meridian_6-week-trial-plan.pdf (outline, owners, checkpoints)

Thanks — excited to move forward.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0183

From: Aisha Singh <aisha@meridiancommerce.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + Proposed 6-week Trial Outline for Meridian Commerce

Ben —

Appreciate the recap and the clear plan. Raj and I reviewed it quickly; overall the timeline looks good. A few clarifications and tweaks on success criteria below:

- Success criteria updates:
  * Intent capture precision target: 80% (we can extend labeling to hit this if needed)
  * Latency: target is p95 < 150ms for our production traffic shape (we can do <120ms for an isolated test, but our real traffic has longer seqs)
  * Cost: we need a cost projection that includes peak-hour traffic; can your Optimize tool simulate that?

- Other asks:
  1) Can you provide a short security note on data retention for the Private trial (KMS, logs retention policy)?
  2) We will supply anonymized sample traffic by Apr 9.
  3) Procurement: I looped internal procurement but they may need a trial MSA — can you send our legal the trial terms (I can provide the contact).

Kickoff: Apr 6 works for a 30–45 minute kickoff. Attendees: Raj Patel (CTO), myself (product), and likely one engineering manager (I'll confirm).

If you can update the plan with the tightened success criteria and a cost projection sketch, we can confirm and share with Procurement.

Thanks,
Aisha
Head of Product | Meridian Commerce
aisha@meridiancommerce.com

- Kickoff call: Apr 6, 10:00 AM PT — proposed invite sent (please confirm)

If that all looks right I'll mark the HubSpot deal MER-482 as "trial agreed" and loop Legal for a short trial MSA.

Best,
Ben

Marissa / Karthik —

Quick internal note to confirm owners for the Meridian trial starting today (kickoff was held — Raj + Aisha attended). Action items from kickoff:

- Marissa: security artifacts + coordinate SOC 2/pen test docs with Meridian security team (they may ask for additional evidence). Can you own outreach and the collection? Target: share baseline pack by Apr 9.
- Karthik: product integration lead (assist with SDK integration, sample traffic ingestion, and latency tuning). Plan: first 2 days pair with Meridian eng to get sample traffic loaded.
- Ben (me): commercial owner — HubSpot updates, procurement contact, and trial acceptance criteria sign-off.

We agreed to run the Private trial in their VPC; infra needs a ticket to infra-ops to allocate a trial instance with GPU profile: 1x A100-equivalent for baseline, plus autoscale with cap. Marissa, can you open the infra ticket and CC me and Karthik?

I'll update HubSpot and attach the signed trial MSA once Legal confirms.

Thanks — let's touch base Thu to confirm sample data ingestion progress.

Ben
